mapper.select: SELECT S.SYMPTMS_NO ,S.SYMPTMS_DTL FROM symptms S WHERE S.SYMPTMS_NM =#{symptmsNm}
SELECT A.ALLRGY_NO ,A.ALLRGY_TY ,A.ALLRGY_SYMPTMS FROM allrgy A WHERE A.ALLRGY_NM = #{allergyNm}

SELECT C.CHLDRN_NO , C.CHLDRN_BRTHDY , C.CHLDRN_SEXDSTN , C.ATCH_CODE , C.CHLDRN_NM , C.CHLDRN_NCNM , CI.CHLDRN_HEIGHT , CI.CHLDRN_BDWGH , CI.CHLDRN_HEAD FROM chldrn C LEFT OUTER JOIN mber_chldrn MC ON MC.CHLDRN_NO = C.CHLDRN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT CI.* FROM chldrn_info CI WHERE CI.CRT_DT = ( SELECT MAX(CRT_DT) FROM chldrn_info WHERE CHLDRN_NO = CI.CHLDRN_NO ) ) CI ON CI.CHLDRN_NO = C.CHLDRN_NO WHERE ( SELECT M.MBER_NO FROM mber M WHERE M.MBER_ID = #{loginMberId} ) = MC.MBER_NO AND C.CHLDRN_DEL_AT = 'N' AND C.CHLDRN_HIDE_AT = 'N' AND C.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo}
SELECT M.MBER_NCNM , M.MBER_ID , M.MBER_NO FROM mber M LEFT OUTER JOIN mber_chldrn MC ON M.MBER_NO = MC.MBER_NO WHERE MC.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo}

WITH LBR AS ( SELECT V.* , VR.VACNTN_INOCL_DT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY V.VACNTN_ICTSD ORDER BY VR.CRT_DT DESC) AS RN FROM vacntn_rcord VR LEFT OUTER JOIN chldrn C ON C.CHLDRN_NO = VR.CHLDRN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN vacntn V ON V.VACNTN_NO = VR.VACNTN_NO WHERE C.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} ) SELECT * FROM LBR WHERE RN = 1 AND LBR.VACNTN_ODR != LBR.VACNTN_CNT
